name: commit-trace-manifest
description: Authority for the sdt.commit span manifests. means/19 links to RENDERED-VIEWS.md; it does not duplicate these tables.

boundaries.name: success
boundaries.stateAssertion: full write; COMPLETE before response

boundaries.name: validation-reject
boundaries.stateAssertion: no attempt identity yet; zero downstream calls

boundaries.name: bootstrap-reject
boundaries.stateAssertion: zero journal/tag writes

boundaries.name: reservation-failure
boundaries.stateAssertion: cancel fan-out covers every consistency tag (forceTombstone)

boundaries.name: allocator-failure

conditionalRows.predicate: allocator reached its bootstrap finalize before failing

boundaries.stateAssertion: S09 only when the allocator reached its finalize

boundaries.name: partial-handoff-to-alarm
boundaries.stateAssertion: alarm side lives in sdt.commit.reconcile/v1

rows.start: after allocator transaction commit, before handoff call

boundaries.name: success
boundaries.stateAssertion: permit released once after full write

boundaries.name: permit-acquire-reject
boundaries.stateAssertion: no permit created; zero event/tag writes

boundaries.name: permit-prepare-reject
boundaries.stateAssertion: proven no-write: allocator vector absent

boundaries.name: permit-prepare-response-loss
boundaries.stateAssertion: P02a idempotent retry (retry.index>=1); allocation 0-call until success confirmed; then normal continuation

boundaries.name: permit-handoff-requery-active-allocate-retry
boundaries.stateAssertion: requeried permit == ACTIVE_ALLOCATE: P02b same-tuple retry required (retry.index>=1); append 0-call before success

boundaries.name: permit-handoff-requery-active-append-continue
boundaries.stateAssertion: requeried permit == ACTIVE_APPEND: P02b cardinality exactly 1 (double CAS forbidden); continuation

boundaries.name: permit-handoff-requery-alarm-handoff
boundaries.stateAssertion: either permit state may hand off; P02b retry.index recorded so the retry decision is derivable from row evidence

boundaries.name: permit-handoff-requery-mismatch-failclosed
boundaries.stateAssertion: owner/digest mismatch, missing, or unexpected terminal: typed fail-closed, event/tag write 0-call

boundaries.name: permit-append-validation-reject
boundaries.stateAssertion: TAG append 0-call; no direct terminal; active permit handed to alarm

boundaries.name: permit-resolve-failure
boundaries.stateAssertion: must not release; stays RESOLVING for alarm/repair

boundaries.name: permit-release-response-loss
boundaries.stateAssertion: P05 retry.index 0..n; converges to one released tombstone with the same evidence digest

rows.start: before the SEQUENTIAL seal loop over allTags
rows.end: loop complete (members are ordered, not parallel)

rows.start: before the parallel cancel barrier over consistencyTags

pre-allocation-vector-absent.factPredicate: Journal state is ADMITTED/RESERVED and readAllocatorVector returns undefined; recoverPreAllocationCommit cancels every consistency reservation and then terminates. It does NOT take over the owner epoch.

conditionalRows.predicate: the record was RESERVED with a reservationFailure, so the terminal transition is used
otherwise the attempt is abandoned through applyReconciliation

journal-pre-allocation-vector-present.factPredicate: Journal is ADMITTED/RESERVED but readAllocatorVector returns a vector; applyReconciliation converges the record to ALLOCATED because the vector is the durable authority. This invocation does NOT terminate: a later alarm runs post-allocation recovery.
journal-pre-allocation-vector-present.terminalOutcome: NON-TERMINAL: converges to ALLOCATED and hands over to the post-allocation path

post-allocation-full-write.factPredicate: state is ALLOCATED/WRITING/SEALING and the batch requery finds EVERY candidate present, so reconciliation converges to COMPLETE

conditionalRows.predicate: schemaVersion == v2 AND an active permit exists for this attempt

post-allocation-full-write.terminalOutcome: COMPLETE terminal (full batch requery found every candidate)

post-allocation-no-write.factPredicate: state is ALLOCATED/WRITING/SEALING and every tag is proven un-written; beginAlarmTakeover raises the owner epoch, then the sequential seal loop runs

conditionalRows.predicate: schemaVersion == v2 AND an active permit exists for this attempt

post-allocation-partial-write.factPredicate: state is ALLOCATED/WRITING/SEALING with at least one tag written and at least one not

conditionalRows.predicate: schemaVersion == v2 AND an active permit exists for this attempt

post-allocation-partial-write.terminalOutcome: PARTIAL terminal; permit stays active for repair

permit-release-won.factPredicate: v2 only: the old owner release won the Bootstrap CAS before this transfer
permit-release-won.terminalOutcome: stop after re-verifying RELEASED evidence (tag mutation 0-call)

permit-transfer-won.factPredicate: v2 only: this recovery won the Bootstrap permit transfer CAS

permit-corrupt-missing.factPredicate: v2 only: permit record missing, or owner/digest mismatch

terminalAtEntryBoundary.name: terminal-at-entry
terminalAtEntryBoundary.factPredicate: durable.prefix.at_entry == terminal: the alarm fired on an already-terminal record

fields.firedGenerationId: durable id of the alarm generation that started THIS handler; R00 records this one
fields.scheduledGenerationId: durable id created by the R01 re-arm inside this handler (the NEXT generation)

rules.text: handler entry: firedGenerationId := the scheduledGenerationId observed at entry
R01 transaction: fired unchanged, scheduled_old -> scheduled_new
platform retry after throw: same firedGenerationId, retryCount incremented, isRetry true
self re-armed fire: firedGenerationId equals the previous scheduledGenerationId, retryCount resets to 0
never reattribute a handler to the generation it scheduled

mutations.text: reattribute all spans to the latest generation
use retryCount as the invocation-uniqueness key

v1.note: must remain satisfiable with no permit facts at all

v2.note: binds to durable facts so a crash between transfer and seal can resume

rows.end: acquire/renew call response (there is no release call; LeaseContext lifetime is execution-local)
rows.successCardinality: distinct tags that actually reach ensureLease (dry-run: 0; all-items-resume-skip: 0; several items on one tag: 1)

rows.end: branch-specific terminal durable evidence (ROLLED_FORWARD/EXCLUDED_AUDITED: resolution+audit; FAILED_CLOSED: resolution only, audit forbidden)
plan entry produced (no lease, no mutation)
rows.successCardinality: dry-run items over the FULL workset distinct tags (maxItems bounds mutating execution only, not the dry-run plan read)

boundaries.name: dry-run
boundaries.stateAssertion: lease and mutation 0-call; X03p counts distinct tags of the FULL workset

boundaries.name: all-items-resume-skip
boundaries.stateAssertion: ensureLease never reached, so X02 cardinality is 0; durable write 0-call

boundaries.name: execute-mutating-single-tag

conditionalRows.predicate: the attempt reached RESOLVED_SAFE in this execution

boundaries.stateAssertion: several mutating items on one tag reuse one lease: X02 == 1, X03e == N

boundaries.name: execute-failed-closed
boundaries.stateAssertion: FAILED_CLOSED writes a resolution but NO audit; X03e ends at the resolution record; X01 forbidden

parentLinks.note: X02 ends at the acquire/renew response, so X03e must NOT be its child

attempt.id.note: repair roots are multi-attempt; per-attempt rows carry it

activation.id.note: callee rows only; observation-only, never persisted or branched on

member.index.note: every fan-out or sequential member row (S14 is v1-only and disappears with G36-2)

tag.key_hash.note: every member row; raw tag values are never emitted

http.status.note: required on spans that receive a Response; forbidden on alarm-root, re-arm and local-CAS spans

script.version.note: adapter input; never an authority and never a control branch

alarm.event.id.note: framework durable alarm generation that fired this handler; root only

recovery.kind.note: the kind is only decided after the allocator-vector requery, and a Cloudflare span cannot be updated after it ends, so ONLY the root (which ends last) may carry it

repair.lease.id.note: required on X02 and on X03e (the link key back to X02)
